character_spec.geometry: One editable cranial+facial outline: 23 ordered lower ANAT1 mesh anchors and 11 new parietal/frontal cranium anchors; asymmetric smooth near/far temporal recess; 54 localized 3-color pressure traces plus 3 × 114 short value contacts and 5 subtle construction guide traces. No ears, eyes, nose, lips, clothing, hairstyle, neck, photo filters or old woman geometry. Exact-native scans and independently observed reference are separate quality gates.

five_axes.topology: One SVG-native head contour joins the face mesh to eleven separately drafted cranial vault anchors and rounds the parietal apex. No flat trapezoid or bilateral wasp-waist. five_axes.vector_flow: Six independently oriented anatomical pigment regions (cranial, near/far temple, near/far malar, mandible) plus three separate curved low-pressure construction fans. No repeated full-screen diagonal hatch texture.
five_axes.weight: 6 anatomy-anchored local pigment fields (cranial, temporal, far-temple, malar, opposite malar, mandibular); unlike screen-wide hatches, each has independently curved 3-colour stroke families; the far cheek is deliberately lighter and narrower, jaw has warm half-tone. No existing line/texture detail removed.
five_axes.rhythm: 3 × 114 short strokes follow three bony guides with deterministic irregular offsets, not wallpaper
five_axes.texture: 54 independently editable, low-pressure, locally feathered pigment traces (six 3-color anatomical fields × 3 group cohorts), original 342 construction contacts and subtle projected guides, natural paper tooth; no bitmaps, photo edits or blanket gradients.
